sentences.text: The case of the petitioners is that land bearing Sy.No.4/1 measuring to an extent of 4 acres 21 guntas at Doddagollahalli Village, Kundana Hobli, Devanahalli Taluk, Bengaluru Rural District, was acquired for purposes of the Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board ('KIADB' for short).
However, respondent no.3 has passed a general award and deposited the compensation in the Reference Court.
It is further submitted by the petitioners that they are desirous of getting developed land instead of monetary compensation for the acquired land.

2. The learned counsel appearing for the respondents submit that they have no objection to pass a consent award provided the petitioners produce all the relevant documents to show that they are the owners of the properties acquired.
It is further submitted that if the policy of the Government permits allotment of developed land in lieu of monetary compensation, even that will be considered.

Under similar circumstances, this Court in umpteen number of cases has permitted the land losers to claim compensation as per the consent award upon establishing the fact that they are the owners of the property.
There is no reason why a similar order should not be passed in the instant case also.
